title: Glenda H NDE 981
content:
When I was 14 or maybe 16 years old, I lived in Omaha, Nebraska. On the weekends, I would go to work with my uncle. He worked at a 24 hour gas station. On a Friday night, I went to sleep about 3 a.m. and it was cold in my uncle's car. Most of the time, I could stay up and work with him, but that night it was too cold. He asked me if I wanted the car engine left on until I went to sleep. I told him, 'No, I'll be all right.' After I went to sleep, he came and turned on the car, just out of thoughtfulness. The car had an exhaust leak, so when we were in it, the windows had to be half way down. As he was starting the car, a customer pulled up, so he was interrupted and forgot to roll down the front windows of the car a little bit. He told me that the car was running for about 45 minutes. I left my body. I traveled in darkness and sadness until I found light and comfort. A being was sitting on a throne and asked me to sit next to him. (Yes, it was a man.) Before I sat down, I saw others who were behind him. I asked, 'Who are they? My angels? Oh, am I an angel too?' I was told, 'Not at this time, soon you will be.' I could hear the voices saying, 'We'll miss you, remember you, and also wait for you.' Somehow, I knew that though. Leaving was not what I wanted to do. I liked it there with the feeling of great compassion and I can't explain the wonderful feeling. The light told me that I had to go back. I asked, 'Why?' The reply was, 'Your life was not intended to be taken by another.' So, I sat down, knowing I couldn't stay. He then showed me a little of my life in the past. He told me that I still had to learn one of life's lessons. He told me of the future that I will love the father of my children that I could touch the face of God with that kind of love. I remember feeling that I will return to this place. All of a sudden, the light started to go away, but the voice was still with me telling me that nobody was there to revive my earthly body. I was told, 'You must leave or your soul will live in mysteries forever. Wake up and urinate.' My uncle told me that when he saw me crawling out of the car in what he called 'a deep sleepwalk'; he knew what had happened. I kept repeating, 'I must urinate now, I must urinate now…' He helped me to a chair. He was saying that my body was limp, as if I was dead. Then, I wet my pants because the voice had told me to urinate. As my life continues on earth, I remember more of the experience and it seems as if my whole life time was spent there.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Traveled in darkness and sadness until finding light and comfort.

arrival.other_being_detail: A male being sitting on a throne; others behind him (interpreted/asked about as angels).

environment.environment_other_detail: A being on a throne; darkness transitioned to light and comfort.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Told: "Your life was not intended to be taken by another." Also warned: "You must leave or your soul will live in mysteries forever."
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Light went away; voice remained instructing her to wake up and urinate.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told she still had to learn one of life's lessons.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Carbon monoxide poisoning from an exhaust leak while sleeping in a running car with windows not rolled down.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE followed by darkness/sadness (void-like travel), then light/comfort with a throne-seated being and others, brief past-life showing and future information, then told to return and instructed to wake up.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Return instruction included a specific bodily directive: "Wake up and urinate."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Your life was not intended to be taken by another."; "Not at this time, soon you will be."; "We'll miss you, remember you, and also wait for you."; "You must leave or your soul will live in mysteries forever. Wake up and urinate."
